user.title: Level account
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the Level app. The password is only used to unlock your keychain and is not stored.

error.tfa: This account has 2FA enabled; OTP login is not supported yet.
error.keychain_failed: Signed in, but could not unlock the Level keychain. Please open an issue and attach the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_devices: No locks were found on this Level account.

dump_gatt.name: Dump GATT
dump_gatt.description: Connect to visible Level locks and return their service and characteristic map.

address.name: Address
address.description: Bluetooth address of one device to dump. Leave empty to dump every device that looks like a Level lock.

handshake.name: Capture handshake
handshake.description: Run the Bixby user key exchange (M1–M4) with a lock you have set up, or for any other device send M1 and return what it notifies.

address.name: Address
address.description: Bluetooth address of the lock. Required when more than one Level lock is visible.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to wait for each reply from the lock (or to listen, when only capturing).

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: bixby: the binary key exchange the Level app uses for account locks (default). skyline: the older protobuf message, for comparison.
